## JsonlStrategyRunLedgerArchive

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Strategies.Storage.JsonlStrategyRunLedgerArchive</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Storage/JsonlStrategyRunLedgerArchive.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Storage/JsonlStrategyRunLedgerArchive.cs#L17).

Write-once, content-addressed JSONL journals for completed simulation runs. Lifecycle history selects the authoritative content hash; rejected candidates cannot poison a run identity. This research archive is separate from governed accounting books and grants no posting authority.
